domain: Portable laboratories, scientific inquiry, experiments, facilities, instruments, measurement, and research workflows
contributionSummary: Owns portable laboratory and experiment semantics, scientific inquiry, facility and instrument definitions, measurement context, laboratory-specific staffing and governance, research provenance, and educational/research workflows. Physics owns mathematical and physical models; FSM_Execution owns workflow lifecycle and execution; SURPS owns shared roleplaying ontology, CORE rules, global book identity, and composition. The sourcebooks distinguish descriptive domain knowledge from executable capabilities and do not claim a complete runtime adapter.

rulebookCoordination.policy: SURPS is the canonical cross-repository registry. Laboratories owns laboratory domain knowledge, scientific inquiry, facility and instrument definitions, and laboratory-specific staffing. Physics owns physical and mathematical models; FSM_Execution owns execution lifecycle; SURPS composes shared ontology and roleplaying semantics without absorbing domain implementations.

blockers: Three declared Laboratory sourcebooks need independent SURPS ownership review and confirmation of their domain boundaries.
The final development-branch manifest and canonical catalogue snapshot must be verified and recorded as central admission evidence.
The repository-local sourcebook validator and CI gate must run successfully before active admission.
